theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: XLE proxy is both trend-gate eligible and the rotation challenger, with the strongest durability_bar (0.69) and highest breadth (0.955) among eligible themes. The trend leg is the only validated edge; crowding (z=1.03) is a sizing caution, not a fade. This is a low-conviction conditional lean that the confirmed energy leadership persists near-term while the absolute-trend gate remains green.
evidence: rotation.challenger with score 1.415 (second only to ineligible memory_storage)
gate_helps true — trend gate is the validated leg
theses.dissent: Energy is crowded and the headline theme; if this is late-stage leadership, the absolute-trend gate has no return edge and only limits drawdown on exit — the directional call contributes nothing beyond passive beta.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its own 50-day average and the energy_complex theme drops out of eligible (trend-gate off) before the 20-day check-by

theses.subject: Big Pharma
